result.stdout:
vidyano — run .visc scripts against a Vidyano service

Usage:
  vidyano run   <file.visc> [options]   Execute a single script.
  vidyano test  <path...> [options]      Run a suite (files/dirs/globs); 
aggregate exit code.
  vidyano lint  <file.visc>                  Parse-check without executing.
  vidyano repl  [options]                     Start an interactive .visc REPL.
  vidyano lsp                            Run the .visc language server over 
stdio (for editors).
  vidyano help  [verbs]                      Show help. 'verbs' lists every 
.visc verb.

Options shared by run/test/repl:
  --app <uri>            Base URI of the Vidyano service (overrides script's 
@app).
  --var key=value        Pre-seed a script variable. Repeatable.
  --mode navigation|audit|direct
                          Guard mode (overrides script's @mode).
  --tools <path.dll>      Load an external tool pack (IVidyanoScriptToolPack). 
Repeatable.
  --seed <int>           Fix the {{@uuid}}/{{@random}} sequence (next value per 
reference).
  --now <iso-datetime>   Anchor the run clock for {{@today}}/{{@now}} (then 
flows by real elapsed).
  --env-prefix <prefix>  Bind matching env vars into the variable table, prefix 
stripped (VIDYANO_REGION -> {{REGION}}). --var wins.
  --env-file <path>      Load KEY=VALUE pairs from a .env for {{env:NAME}} / 
SIGN-IN FROM ENV (shadows the process env). Repeatable; last wins.
  --file-root <dir>      Root for SET attr = FILE "<path>" reads; paths can't 
escape it. Default: the script's directory.
  --json                   NDJSON output (one event per line). On lint, emits 
machine-readable diagnostics.
  --verbose                Show per-statement snapshot detail.
  --insecure               Bypass TLS validation (local dev certs only).

Options for run/test:
  --timeout <dur>        Per-file timeout: 30s, 2m, 1h, or 0 (off). Default: 
off.
Options for test:
  --report <fmt>[:path]  Emit a report. fmt = junit|tap|sarif. Repeatable; no 
:path writes to stdout.
  --jobs <n>             Run up to n files
[truncated]
